extracted.name: Cucumber-Mango Salsa
extracted.description: This cucumber-mango salsa includes diced mangoes, onion, cucumber, jalapeños, fresh cilantro, and fresh lime juice. This quick recipe yields four cups.
ingredient_lines: 2 jalapeno peppers, seeded and finely chopped
1 tablespoon lime juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Combine mangoes, onion, cucumber, jalapeños, cilantro, and garlic in a mixing bowl; season with lime juice, salt, and black pepper. Refrigerate to allow flavors to blend before serving, at least 2 hours.
